paper_metadata.title: Mg-Cu-Y Bulk Amorphous Alloys with High Tensile Strength Produced by a High-Pressure Die Casting Method

evidence.quote: Amorphous Mg-Cu-Y alloys with diameters (or thicknesses) ranging from I to 7 mm were formed in cylinder and sheet forms by using a high-pressure die casting process.
